description: This file declares the class TensorListSetItemSPMDExpander, which is responsible for expanding and computing layout transformations for the 'tensorlist.setitem' operation within the TensorFlow DTensor MLIR pipeline. It provides method declarations for expanding the operation and computing input/output layouts.
external_methods: StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& input_layouts)

classes.name: TensorListSetItemSPMDExpander
classes.description: A class that handles expanding the 'tensorlist.setitem' operation and computing data layouts for forward and backward transformations within the DTensor MLIR framework.

methods.description: Expands the 'tensorlist.setitem' operation into its lower-level MLIR representation.
